# Fictional walkthrough: an existing private repository with local overrides

This is a synthetic example. It names no real destination and makes no claim about any of the fourteen Jevelopers repositories.

## Observed conflict

Assume an existing private repository already has a README, CONTRIBUTING, and a local AGENTS.md. Its contributor guide says to use the repository's current branch naming and review roles. A shared default draft proposes a different convention. The local source revision and exact text are not supplied in this example, so both remain unknown.

The correct next step is to preserve the local files, link each source/revision in a decision request, and ask the destination owner to decide whether to adapt or link the shared procedure. Do not overwrite the local instructions or assume the private repository inherits a public .github default.
